info.name: DNSFilter Agent Local User Bulk Deletes Agent Local Users API

params.name: block_page
params.description: Filter by block page name

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Filter by collection

params.name: cybersight_enabled
params.description: When true, use OpenSearch for activity in the time window: without user_agent_uuids, return extant ALUs seen on any Cybersight-eligible roaming client in the org(s); with user_agent_uuids, return ALUs seen on those roaming clients. When false, use Postgres only (default: false)

params.name: end_at
params.description: ISO8601 end of activity window. Optional; only used with start_at when cybersight_enabled=true.

params.name: friendly_name
params.description: Filter by friendly name

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter to users whose IDs are in the specified list of values

params.name: in_a_collection
params.description: filter by agent local users in a collection

params.name: msp_id
params.description: MSP ID. When provided, returns agent local users across all organizations belonging to this MSP.

params.name: name
params.description: filter by name. If friendly_name not found, will search by user_name

params.name: organization_ids
params.description: Organization IDs, defaults to user organization ID

params.name: page
params.description: Page number and size

params.name: policy_schedule
params.description: Filter by policy or scheduled policy name

params.name: search
params.description: Filter by name or user_login

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort options, valid attributes: name, first_seen, last_seen. Prefix with - for descending (e.g. -first_seen)

params.name: start_at
params.description: ISO8601 start of activity window. Optional; only used when cybersight_enabled=true. Omitted => last 91 days unless paired with end_at.

params.name: user_agent_uuids
params.description: Filter to users associated with these roaming clients. When cybersight_enabled=true uses Cybersight activity (OpenSearch); otherwise uses current user on device (PG).

params.name: user_login
params.description: Filter by user login

params.name: user_name
params.description: Filter by username

params.name: user_policy_override
params.description: When true, return only users with a policy or scheduled policy directly assigned. When false, return only users without a direct policy or scheduled policy assignment.
